release_read.basis: Preliminary FY2027 guide of $600-700m revenue and $40-50m adj. EBITDA is roughly double the ~$306m single-source consensus the thesis named, with FY2026 affirmed at $290-310m and a Q3 EPS of -$0.17 vs Nasdaq's -$0.21; offsets are an in-line $13.1m Q3, a very back-end-loaded Q4 implied by the FY26 guide, and backlog of $2.3B rather than the ~$3B the hunt expected. Sized near the 16% option-implied move into a ~21% short float.

key_line.detail: Preliminary FY2027 revenue $600-700m, adj. EBITDA $40-50m; backlog $2.3B; cash $236m at 9/30. Q3 gross margin flattered by tariff refunds (37.9% GAAP ex-refunds).

guidance.detail: FY2026 affirmed at $290-310m (top half of the old $270-310m range, as pre-announced 10-14); new FY2027 $600-700m against a street near $306m.

call.detail: Call held last night; content not reviewed in the time available. After-hours traded -5.1% vs the close, the pre-market reversed to +7.6%, so the overnight read moved toward the guide.

public_reaction.summary: No dated analyst action or press reaction for this morning found in one search; nothing to report.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 3.80 (+7.6%) vs release read +15% and implied 16%. Pre-market is alive (74 prints, 7 in the last 30m, last 09:15, not stale). Path: after-hours -5.1% (3.35), pre-market low 3.40, high 4.08 (+15.6%), now sagged to 3.80: it ran up and gave half back, so sellers met the guide-driven bid.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was a first FY27 guide far above ~$306m consensus; the guide came at $600-700m. Backlog ($2.3B) is below the ~$3B the hunt cited and Q3 was light, the stated caveats.

expected.open_lag_note: Active pre-market with no stale flag, so the open should hold most of +7.6%; an amc gap that already sagged from +15.6% to +7.6% tends to give a little more back by 10:00, against which the 21% short float and an undershoot vs the guide argue, so the fade is only modestly favoured.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de these (voorlopige omzetverwachting 2027 van 600-700 miljoen dollar, ongeveer het dubbele van wat analisten hadden), en de positie staat voorbuurs ruim 10% in de plus. De koers liep voorbuurs al op tot 4,08 en zakte terug naar 3,80, en na de bekendmaking gisteravond stond hij zelfs lager; dat wisselvallige beeld is geen reden om van de vaste regel af te wijken, dus verkopen bij de opening.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de koers voor 09:30 weer boven 4,00 dollar uitkomt en daar blijft handelen, is aanhouden tot het slot (of een limiet rond 4,08) te verdedigen.
